notes.title: Embers Off in Steam Awards 2023
notes.notes:
Have you noticed the most unique feature Embers Off has? ~ 'Emotions'. 
Embers Off connects you emotionally with its story-rich cinematic scenes. The music drives your heart to the struggles faced by the Indian National Army in 1942 - World War 2 times. The dialogues express the love inside those fighters who were ready to sacrifice their lives for their nation. The whole game is just 'love' based; love for nation and the aggression for the oppressors. The direction, sequencing, dialogues, framing, and shots were all carried by us with a mission of creating a sense of 'love' in the players' minds even if they don't belong from India. 'Overall a pleasure is felt after playing the game' - That's what most of the reviews speak. 

Winning this Outstanding Story Rich Game award would help the story of Embers Off reach more hearts, making more people gratified, just like you got after playing it. Winning an award would help our small team create our next game with a more heart-touching story and great gameplay.

Thank you for reading!
IfThenElse Digital

notes.title: Reveal Trailer | Embers Off
notes.notes:
Here's the Embers Off Reveal Trailer (Cinematic): [url=https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=CaKUS433LPY]Watch Here[/url]

Embers Off is an Action Game that takes you to the most epic historical event in the times of World War II - the journey of the Indian National Army/Azaad Hind Fauj for their eminent ambition of acquiring India's independence from Britain. From the Japanese incursion of Singapore in 1942, this great story of INA began.

We're announcing the official release date as [b]September 29[/b].
